library.title: My library
library.noPlan: My library comes with the Streamer plan.
library.noPlanHint: Subscriptions are in a meeting's Settings.
library.warn: You've used {pct}% of your {gb} GB storage.
library.kept: Your subscription has ended. Your library is kept until {date}, then deleted. Renew it in a meeting's Settings to keep it.
library.empty: Nothing saved yet. Recordings you save from a meeting appear here.
library.shareNote: Anyone with this whole link can watch it until you turn it off. The key is the part after #; it never reaches GifOS.
library.loadFailed: Your library could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
library.unsupported: This browser cannot play this file here. Download it instead.
library.keyNote: Only you can open these. If you lose your subscription file and its backup, nobody — not even GifOS — can recover them.
library.sharedNote: Shared with you from a GifOS library. It opens in this browser; the key in the link never reaches GifOS.
library.wrongKey: This file cannot be opened with this key.
library.shareNoKey: This link is missing its key. Ask for the whole link.
library.shareGone: This share link has been turned off by its owner, or the file was deleted.
library.noStream: This browser cannot open large files here. Try a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
